object.name: Traceweave witness (illustrative)
object.description: Illustrative only; no such service exists. Receives the SHA-256 of a registrant's DSSE signature, never content or fingerprints, and returns a signed, time-stamped witness statement. It does not show who created the content, that it is original, that the registrant was first to create it, who owns it, or that its use is permitted. First to register is not first to create. Comparing the times of two registrations does not show which was made first. A registration made by or through an agent shows which key signed it and, for a hosted witness, which authenticated caller presented the digest; it does not show whether a person or an agent created the content, or on whose behalf.

skills.name: Witness a registration digest
skills.description: Records that the authenticated caller presented this signature digest, signs a witness statement and attaches the witness's own RFC 3161 token. It does not register content, check authorship or check originality. It does not show who created the content, that it is original, that the registrant was first to create it, who owns it, or that its use is permitted. First to register is not first to create. Comparing the times of two registrations does not show which was made first. A registration made by or through an agent shows which key signed it and, for a hosted witness, which authenticated caller presented the digest; it does not show whether a person or an agent created the content, or on whose behalf.
